name: crossmod-claims-flan-stranger
description: Issues #186, #208: BuildCraft machines (Quarry, Builders, Filler, stripes pipe, Stripes robot, Pump, Flood Gate) owned by the dev player beside a claim that is flan-stranger's, aimed into it (rig B), against the same rig with no claim (A) and with a claim the dev owns (C). Generated by generators/gen_crossmod_claims.py, whose docstring describes the rig. Rig B's claim is the dev's like rig C's and rig B's machines are owned by a stranger (its robot is deployed by the dev, its station pipe is the stranger's).
